statement: test_object_style_none_content duplicates test_object_style_response with content swapped to None, but the object branch has no dedicated empty-content path, so grubbing works for both inputs the same way and the test is redundant.

test_empty_content_string and test_content_is_string both hand the same '' string to _extract; the content_len==0 assertion does not pin the empty-string result the name implies, so both pass if that branch regresses to kicking and the test cannot fail.

test_upstream_empty_false_on_failure passes exception as FakeException(500) but injects it into response_obj, not kwargs, while dropping kwargs' exception key, so the failure path is never exercised on _emit and the false assertion is trivially satisfied.

test_emit_with_none_kwargs only asserts a lone sentinel string is absent from captured output, so a silent no-op emit with no PROXY_LOG line at all would also pass; no emission or shape is ever checked.

test_log_stream_success_event asserts the byte-exact empty output of a pass statement body; a no-op can be broken only by adding code, which any caller or review would notice, so the test defends nothing about streaming behavior.

test_original_response_is_string passes a raw string as original_response; the input-locating loop in _extract_http_info rejects it as an input type before any extraction runs, so the is-None assertion tests the rejection branch, not a missing-headers path.

test_sha_defaults_to_unknown_when_env_and_git_both_fail runs with the working tree's BUILD_SHA unset but relies on an ambient env state that the repo's own CI could violate; combined with a duplicated failure test it is a fragile double of test_sha_unknown_when_git_fails.

Module-export hasattr tests assert a name exists after import, which only passes if the import itself emitted the name; a renamed export is more likely to fail at registration than to be caught by this assertion. Returns nothing about behavior.

The claude-status URL-validation shell tests (1e-1f4 plus hosted and invalid-JSON blocks) each end in an elif that greps proxy_status.py for a substring, so in CI without make the fallback asserts a source line exists, the same check the Python unit suite already runs.
